cannot_say: No Effect variant expresses returning a permanent matching a Filter to its owner's hand as an 'unless' cost or resolution choice; Effect::PlayerMayPayOr only supports paying generic mana (mana: u16), and no Effect variant allows a player to choose and return a permanent matching a Filter to its owner's hand on resolution to prevent a fallback effect.
nearest_existing: Effect::PlayerMayPayOr { player, mana, effect } (which gives a player a choice to pay generic mana or run a fallback Effect, but cannot require returning a permanent matching a Filter) and Effect::ReturnToHand { target: TargetSpec } (which requires a target chosen when placing the ability on the stack, whereas 'return an untapped Island you control to its owner's hand' is an untargeted choice made upon resolution).

name: Cori Mountain Monastery
oracle_sentence: {3}{R}, {T}: Exile the top card of your library. Until the end of your next turn, you may play that card.
cannot_say: No Effect variant exiles cards from the top of a library (only Mill to graveyard, or Exile which requires a TargetSpec), no Modifier variant grants permission to play a card from exile (unlike Modifier::GrantsFlashback for graveyards), and Duration lacks an UntilTheEndOfYourNextTurn variant (only UntilEndOfTurn and UntilYourNextTurn exist).
nearest_existing: Effect::Mill (puts cards from library into graveyard rather than exile), Effect::LookAtTopPick (looks at top cards of library but puts into hand/bottom rather than exile), Modifier::GrantsFlashback (grants permission to cast from graveyard rather than play from exile), and Duration::UntilYourNextTurn / Duration::UntilEndOfTurn (which end at the start of next turn or end of current turn rather than end of next turn).

name: Corrupted Crossroads
oracle_sentence: {T}, Pay 1 life: Add one mana of any color. Spend this mana only to cast a spell with devoid.
cannot_say: No Filter variant can test for the devoid ability: KeywordSet has no DEVOID bit for Filter::HasKeyword, and devoid is not a type, supertype, or subtype.
nearest_existing: Filter::HasKeyword(KeywordSet) matches keyword abilities on objects but KeywordSet lacks a DEVOID bit; Filter::IsColorless checks color rather than the devoid keyword and would incorrectly match non-devoid colorless cards like artifacts and colorless Eldrazi.

name: Country Roads
oracle_sentence: {1}{W}, {T}, Sacrifice this land: Create a 1/1 colorless Pilot creature token with "This token saddles Mounts and crews Vehicles as though its power were 2 greater." Activate only as a sorcery.
cannot_say: Effect::CreateToken requires a &'static TokenDef from crate::tokens::ALL, but crate::tokens defines no 1/1 colorless Pilot creature token, and card files are barred by tokens::tests::no_card_file_defines_its_own_token from defining local TokenDef literals while the single-file editing constraint prevents editing tokens.rs; additionally, the DSL has no AbilityDef or Modifier variant to express crewing or saddling, nor any Modifier variant to adjust effective power conditionally for crewing Vehicles or saddling Mounts.
nearest_existing: Effect::CreateToken { token: &'static TokenDef } exists and creates tokens from crate::tokens::ALL (such as SOLDIER_1_1_WHITE), but cannot create a Pilot token; Modifier::ModifyPT(2, 0) on Layer::PtModify exists to alter power, but modifies power globally rather than effective power specifically when saddling Mounts or crewing Vehicles.

name: Crawling Barrens
oracle_sentence: {4}: Put two +1/+1 counters on this land. Then you may have it become a 0/0 Elemental creature until end of turn. It's still a land.
cannot_say: No Effect variant expresses an optional resolution-time player choice to apply a continuous effect (such as an animation effect). Effect::CreateContinuousEffect applies unconditionally with no optionality or player decision parameter, and AbilityDef::Activated provides no branching or modal mechanism to decline animating the permanent while still placing counters.
nearest_existing: Effect::CreateContinuousEffect { layer, filter, modifier, duration } exists and can express the individual layer modifications for animating into a 0/0 Elemental creature until end of turn (Modifier::AddType(TypeSet::CREATURE), Modifier::AddSubtype(subtypes::creature::ELEMENTAL), and Modifier::SetPT(0, 0)), but falls short because it applies unconditionally with no mechanism for the player to optionally decline becoming a creature ('Then you may have it become...'); and AbilityDef::CopyOnEnterUntilEot expresses an optional until-EOT transformation ('you may have it become...'), but only as an ETB replacement effect rather than a resolution-time choice during an activated ability.

name: Crosis's Catacombs
oracle_sentence: When this land enters, sacrifice it unless you return a non-Lair land you control to its owner's hand.
cannot_say: No Effect variant expresses an 'unless you [action]' condition with a non-mana action (such as returning a permanent to hand): Effect::PlayerMayPayOr only accepts generic mana (mana: u16) as the condition to prevent an effect, and Effect::ReturnToHand requires a TargetSpec chosen upon triggering rather than an untargeted permanent chosen on resolution.
nearest_existing: Effect::PlayerMayPayOr is the closest variant for 'sacrifice it unless...', but it falls short because its cost is restricted to generic mana (mana: u16). Effect::ReturnToHand is the closest variant for returning a permanent to hand, but it falls short because it operates on a TargetSpec (chosen when putting the ability on the stack) rather than allowing a player to choose and return an untargeted permanent on resolution.

name: Crossroads Village
oracle_sentence: As it enters, choose a color.
cannot_say: No EnterModifier variant exists to choose or record a chosen color as a permanent enters the battlefield, and no ManaSource variant in Effect::AddMana references a color chosen as the source entered the battlefield.
nearest_existing: EnterModifier::ChooseSubtype exists for choosing a creature subtype as a permanent enters the battlefield, but only supports SubtypeId; ManaSource::Choice exists for choosing a color upon resolution of each activation, but cannot produce the color chosen as the permanent entered.

name: Crucible of the Spirit Dragon
oracle_sentence: {T}, Remove X storage counters from this land: Add X mana in any combination of colors. Spend this mana only to cast Dragon spells or activate abilities of Dragons.
cannot_say: No CostPart variant expresses removing counters (or a variable X number of counters) from the source permanent as an activation cost; no Amount variant captures counters removed to scale the mana produced (Amount::X only evaluates cast-time X on spells); and ManaRestriction only restricts mana to casting spells matching a Filter, with no construct to restrict spending to activating abilities of Dragons.
nearest_existing: CostPart::PayLifeX (allows paying a variable X amount as a cost, but only for life on spells, not counters on permanents); Amount::X (evaluates the cast-time X of a spell, but cannot reference counters removed as a cost); and Effect::AddMana with ManaRestriction { filter, rider } (restricts mana spending only to casting spells matching a Filter, not activating abilities).
